# Load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(robotstxt)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidygeocoder)
```


# Import "rawData" into this qmd file
```{r}
dataset <- load("data/rawData.Rdata")
```

# Add a new column to the data that displays the coordinates of each institution
# Use the package tidygeocoder to turn addresses into coordinates
```{r}
# Needed to change the dataset "df" from a "tibble" type (which is used by tidyverse) back into a "data.frame" to be able to run geocode
dataset_with_coordinates <- as.data.frame(df) |>
  mutate(
    # Some zipcodes exceed 5 digits, trim them down to 5 digits using str_sub
    zipcode = str_sub(zip_text, start = 1, end = 5),
    
    # Create a new column that combines address, zipcode, and city (to get better coordinates)
    # str_c() combines multiple pieces of text into one text
    complete_address = str_c(addr1_txt, city_txt, state_cd, zipcode, sep = ", ")
  ) |>
  # Some institutions are "NA" and could not get coordinates
  slice(21:30) |>
  # This is the code that gets the coordinates
  geocode(address = complete_address, method = "osm")
```
